# What the Prisma schema cannot express

**Generated by `scripts/schema-snapshot.js` — do not edit by hand.**

The Prisma schema file describes tables, columns and relations. Its schema
language cannot represent triggers, functions, CHECK constraints, generated
columns or partial indexes. On this database that is
**749 objects**, and a database rebuilt from the Prisma
file alone would be missing every one of them — silently, with no error.

That is why the rule is absolute: **the schema files are for reading. Never
rebuild a database from them.** The 549 numbered migrations in `db/` remain
the only thing that builds this database.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tables | 321 |
| Columns | 5257 |
| Triggers | 33 |
| Functions | 136 |
| CHECK constraints | 249 |
| Generated columns | 12 |
| Partial indexes | 319 |

- **borrowers.full_name** — `btrim(regexp_replace(((((((COALESCE(btrim(first_name), ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(btrim(middle_name), ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(btrim(last_name), ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(btrim(name_suffix), ''::text)), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text))`

- **elementix_lookup_cache.cacheable** — `(status = ANY (ARRAY['found'::text, 'no_match'::text, 'ambiguous'::text]))`
- **properties.address_tsv** — `to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, ((((((((COALESCE(display_address, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(city, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(state, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(zip, ''::text)) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(apn, ''::text)))`
- **properties.baths_total** — `CASE WHEN ((baths_full IS NULL) AND (baths_half IS NULL)) THEN NULL::numeric ELSE ((COALESCE(baths_full, 0))::numeric + ((COALESCE(baths_half, 0))::numeric * 0.5)) END`
- **properties.condition_rank** — `(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(condition_uad, ''::text), '\D'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text), ''::text))::smallint`
- **properties.eff_geo_source** — `CASE WHEN ((geo_latitude IS NOT NULL) AND (geo_longitude IS NOT NULL)) THEN COALESCE(geo_source, 'lookup'::text) WHEN ((geo_latitude IS NULL) AND (geo_longitude IS NULL) AND (latitude IS NOT NULL) AND (longitude IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'appraiser'::text WHEN ((COALESCE(geo_latitude, latitude) IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(geo_longitude, longitude) IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'mixed'::text ELSE NULL::text END`
- **properties.eff_latitude** — `COALESCE(geo_latitude, latitude)`
- **properties.eff_longitude** — `COALESCE(geo_longitude, longitude)`
- **properties.quality_rank** — `(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(quality_uad, ''::text), '\D'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text), ''::text))::smallint`
- **track_records.counts_from** — `COALESCE( CASE WHEN (lower(COALESCE(deal_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%flip%'::text) THEN sale_date ELSE COALESCE(rent_date, refi_date) END, CASE WHEN ((lower(COALESCE(deal_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%ground%'::text) OR (lower(COALESCE(deal_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%construction%'::text)) THEN COALESCE(sale_date, rent_date, refi_date) ELSE NULL::date END)`
- **track_records.hold_days** — `(COALESCE( CASE WHEN (lower(COALESCE(deal_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%flip%'::text) THEN sale_date ELSE COALESCE(rent_date, refi_date) END, CASE WHEN ((lower(COALESCE(deal_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%ground%'::text) OR (lower(COALESCE(deal_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%construction%'::text)) THEN COALESCE(sale_date, rent_date, refi_date) ELSE NULL::date END) - purchase_date)`
